description: List the countries present in the bundled OurAirports dataset with their ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes and airport counts. This is the lookup table for valid `country` (and, with include_regions, `region`) filter values used by ourairports_search_airports. Optionally restrict to a continent or nest each country's regions. Counts exclude closed airports.

continent.description: Restrict to one continent: AF (Africa), AN (Antarctica), AS (Asia), EU (Europe), NA (North America), OC (Oceania), SA (South America).

include_regions.description: When true, nest each country's ISO 3166-2 regions (with airport counts) under it. Off by default to keep the response compact.

name: ourairports_list_countries

countries.description: Countries present in the dataset, sorted by name.

items.description: A country present in the dataset, with its non-closed airport count and ISO code.

airportCount.description: Number of non-closed airports in the country.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (the value to pass as `country` to ourairports_search_airports).

continent.description: Two-letter continent code (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA), or null.

regions.description: Regions within the country with airport counts. Present only when include_regions is true.

items.description: A region within a country, with its non-closed airport count.

airportCount.description: Number of non-closed airports in the region.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the continent filter matched no countries.

title: ourairports-mcp-server
